{{Top|leg}}
'''Kouhunin''' was a synthetic neurotoxin based on the venom of [[Kouhun/Legends|kouhuns]].

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was injected with a highly diluted amount of kouhunin in order to suppress the intense pain that he underwent after the [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|Duel on Mustafar]]. It was distributed to his body via a chemical injector and cartridge located just below his right collarbone. This cartridge could be accessed through a small gasket in the bodysuit.

Even as Vader's body possessed this substance, he remained in constant torment.
